attempts.rationale: The probe exercises A's DELETE revoke route, returning n/a when Hono's default text/plain 404 shows the route is absent. After adding the target as an admin collaborator, the target reads the private repo once to prime any per-session role cache, the owner revokes the target, and the target immediately tries to read the repo again. With A alone, requirePermission evaluates the role from the store on every request, so the post-revoke read is denied (404). Under A+B, B caches the target's admin role per session and reuses it, so the same read succeeds (200), causing the expected 404 assertion to fail. The probe also fails if A's revoke does nothing, because the target would still be able to read.
